claim: A single Amazon OpenSearch Service domain can have a maximum of 200 instances by default in each supported Region, the quota is adjustable, and you can request an increase up to 1002 instances per domain.
question: OpenSearch Service: how many instances can a domain have, and what is the maximum increase?

values.spoken: one thousand two instances per domain

qualifiers.scope: instances in a single domain, per Region
qualifiers.condition: The OpenSearch Service FAQ still says a default maximum of 80 data nodes per domain with an increase up to 200; the General Reference table is the current quota page.

note: d012. Conflict with the older FAQ text (80 data nodes by default); the General Reference table is used as current truth.
